rows.50:52b8:
Seeing {f:me|me} flustered, Arai narrowed his eyes, looking strangely pleased.
"You're scared.
Because of you, I had to apologize to Kazama.
Considering my pride, this is only what you deserve...... But I bet you've learned your lesson, right down to the bone.
I can't free you from It, but I'll let you move."
The moment he said it, my body suddenly felt light.
Arai grinned.
"It seems you've had a good scare in the dark, {a}{f:|}.
I'll have you count this as my fifth story."
{f:I|I} couldn't say a word.{p}{f:And so|...Well then}, at last, it was down to the final one{f:.|.}{p}
rows.50:5dcc:
"Ah..."
{f:I|I} tried to call Arai back.
But no voice came out.
Kazama lay motionless on the floor, his stomach soaked in blood.
"What on earth just happened?"
{f:One of the girls|Someone} said it in a tearful voice.
What had happened......
That was something no one {f:would ever be able to|could possibly} answer.
The stench of blood filled the cramped club room.
Who could have imagined the seven wonders would come to an end like this?
The sobbing of {f:the girls|the others} sounded somehow far away.
{f:I|I} could do nothing but stand there.
No one ever learned where Arai went.{p}
rows.50:87f0:
"...For now, we'd better carry him out of here."
"What★"
I couldn't believe my ears.
Preserving the scene is the duty of every good citizen, and when it's something as serious as a murder, all the more so......
Kazama looked at me as if he'd seen right through what {f:I|I} was thinking.
"You saw it too, didn't you?
Arai was the one who came at me first.
What I did was self-defense."
"B-but if that's the case, couldn't you just call the police and tell them the truth...?"
Kazama shrugged.
"Are you serious?
The police's job is to make criminals.
They'd never believe a word I say in the first place.
Besides, this happened partly because you all didn't stop us, you know."{p}
rows.50:993c:
With the girls keeping watch, {f:we|we} started down the hallway.
If anyone saw us like this, there'd be no excuse...... I thought to myself.
Maybe because of that, my breathing grew ragged.
It felt like only {f:our|our} breathing was echoing loudly through the empty school building.
Kazama must have felt the same way.
"You guys... keep it down a little."
So {f:I|I} held my breath as much as I could too.
But someone was still wheezing.
"Hey, you guys..."
Kazama stopped in mid-sentence.
At the same moment, {f:I|I} realized it too.{p}
